pages.text: $(l)Right-click$() a machine with the $(item)Machine Tagger$() to track it; $(l)sneak + right-click$() to stop. Right-click the air for your list: name each machine, remove tags, and buy more tag slots.$(br2)You can tag only machines you could open yourself. Your slots stay yours if the tagger is lost.

Holding the tagger, your tracked machines nearby show green corner marks and their names, even through walls.$(br2)You start with 2 tag slots. More cost $(item)Copper Shatter Coins$(), a little more for each one.
pages.title: Tags and slots

pages.text: The $(l)HOLO$() button in your inventory opens the $(item)Holo Grid$(). Flip its lever to $(l)BUILD$(), drag on the grid to draw a box, then pick a tracked machine, the map or all your tags from the drawer.$(br2)Up to 9 pages, each with its own grid. Presets keep whole sets of pages.
pages.title: The Holo Grid

pages.text: In $(l)VIEW$() each box shows its machine's own screen, live; a machine without one shows its items, power, fluids and progress. A machine in an unloaded part of the world shows its last reading.$(br2)$(l)POPOUT$() opens the grid in its own window for a second screen. $(l)PIN$() puts one box in a corner of your game screen.
pages.title: Watching

pages.text: To work a machine from the grid, buy $(l)Remote Control$() in the tagger (Diamond Shatter Coins) and stand inside the range of a $(item)Remote Control Transmitter$() that covers the machine. A box marked $(l)OPERATE$() then opens the machine's own screen.
pages.title: Remote Control

pages.text: Reaches 16 blocks each way, plus 16 for every $(item)Range Card$() in its three slots, up to 3,072. It uses FE while someone works a machine through it. You and your team can use it.

A machine screen opened through a transmitter lets you move items inside the machine and use all its buttons and switches. Your own inventory stays closed off unless the transmitter has the $(l)Inventory Link$(): its placer buys it in the transmitter's screen with $(item)Illyrium Shatter Coins$(), and it stays in the transmitter when it is mined.$(br2)Whatever is on your cursor when such a screen closes goes back into the machine, or drops beside it when the machine is full.
pages.title: Inventory Link
